messages:
Ava: Heads-up: 09:05 PT batch of webinar leads landed with no owner. Dashboard spike in unclaimed leads.
Diego: I see it. HubSpot webhook returned 200 but RR didn't fire. We rolled enrichment change last night.
Nora: Quick root cause: RR evaluated before enrichment added `preferred_track`. Condition used that field.
Ava: Mitigation: set temporary default owner to "SDR-Intake" for 15m and backfill unassigned.
HubSpotBot: workflow.update success for workflow id 445 at 09:12:03.
Nora: Backfill ran: 42 leads assigned to SDR-Intake, tagged "auto-temp-assign". No conflicts.
Diego: Hotfix: added 6s delayed re-evaluate that triggers if owner==null. Deployed canary, no errors.
Ava: Can we add telemetry flag for delayed assigns and open RFC to move RR to post-enrichment?
Nora: RFC created (RFC-2026-089). Will include SF mapping checks and tests for missing fields.
Diego: Monitoring looks good. Claim rate back to baseline.
Ava: TL;DR: temp default -> SDR-Intake, backfilled 42 leads, 6s delayed re-eval hotfix, RFC for post-enrichment RR in backlog.
